channel.title: Auralis Release Notes
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 1.2.4
item.description:
What's New in 1.2.4

  • 修复心动模式（智能播放）歌曲重复问题：改用官方 playmode_intelligence_list 接口，返回约 149 首非重复推荐歌曲
  • 修复心动模式参数 Bug：intelligence_list 封装传入 songId 而非 id，此前 API 调用必然失败
  • 新增心动模式播放历史去重：维护已播放歌曲集合，避免推荐列表重叠导致的重复
  • 修复全屏播放器收起时出现蓝色焦点环：添加 focusEffectDisabled
  • 优化全屏播放器动画流畅度：移除昂贵的 scaleEffect 材质变换，改用 move+opacity 过渡
  • 简化全屏播放器收起流程：移除两阶段动画和 180ms 死延迟，收起时间从 ~0.84s 缩短至 ~0.38s

item.title: Version 1.2.3
item.description:
What's New in 1.2.3

  • 修复软件静置后误弹"解码错误"提示:网络瞬断或唤醒后网络未就绪时,歌单刷新等接口不再误报
  • 接口健壮性增强:统一识别并静默处理传输层错误(502/空响应/非200),仅真实解码异常才提示
  • 加固播放链路与登录状态接口的异常处理,错误响应写入日志便于排查

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.2.0

  • Personal FM: AI-powered radio with like/dislike feedback
  • Music Catalog: Browse artists and albums, search, subscribe, and explore top songs
  • Podcasts: Discover, subscribe, and listen to podcast episodes
  • Listening History: Recent listening activity and listening insights
  • Playlist Management: Create, rename, delete, and subscribe to playlists
  • Daily Recommendations: Enhanced daily recommended songs
  • Saved Music: Browse subscribed artists, albums, and playlists

item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.3

  • Fix intelligence mode: use simi_song API for song-based recommendations without requiring playlist context
  • Fix repeat-one mode: replay current song on track end, next, and previous
  • Fix lyric highlighting not resetting when repeating the same song in full-screen player

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.2

  • MV 播放器: Click recommended MVs on Explore to play in a full-screen native video player
  • 原生视频渲染: AVPlayerView with custom overlay controls, auto-hide on playback
  • 按钮点击区域优化: Expanded hit areas across all player controls for easier interaction
  • 修复 MV 播放器退出后卡死问题

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.1

  • 心动模式 (Intelligence Mode): Smart recommendations based on current song
  • 音质选择 (Audio Quality): Choose from Standard to Master quality in Settings
  • 全屏播放器动画优化: Smoother transitions with staggered animations
  • 歌词交互: Click any lyric line to seek, hover effects for better UX
  • 修复全屏播放器进度条颜色突变问题
  • i18n 修复: Sidebar and Explore section headers now properly localized
  • 更换全新 Auralis 应用图标与项目标识
